MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 40

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 6
   D. 8

6. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

7. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

13. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

15. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

16. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
